description.value: A double-blind randomized study tested whether baclofen reduces neural activation elicited by subliminal cocaine cues in cocaine-dependent men using event-related BOLD fMRI and a backward-masking paradigm.

spans.text: Twenty cocaine-dependent participants were randomized to receive baclofen (60 mg/d; 20 mg t.i.d.) or placebo. Event-related BOLD fMRI and a backward-masking paradigm were used to examine the effects of baclofen on subliminal cocaine (vs neutral) cues.
